description: Change what the user's own Parfumo profile shows: gender, country, time zone, the two fragrance preference lines (`i_like`, `i_dont_like`, 250 characters each) and the signature scent. Only the fields given are changed. PUBLIC: these show on the member's profile. Parfumo forbids AI-generated text: the preference lines must be the user's own words, passed on unchanged. Parfumo has no free presentation text, no favourite perfumes list, and the avatar is not handled. Returns the fields as Parfumo holds them after the call. On this server publicly visible writes stay in dry-run mode unless the operator enabled them, with a daily cap per user. Supports dry_run. Requires a linked Parfumo account.

country.description: Country shown on the profile, by its English name as Parfumo lists it (e.g. "Switzerland").

dry_run.description: When true, nothing is sent: the answer shows the requests that would be made.

gender.description: Gender shown on the profile: "male", "female" or "non-binary" (or the site value m / f / d).

i_dont_like.description: "I don't like" line of the fragrance preferences (250 characters at most), in the user's own words. An empty string clears it.

i_like.description: "I like" line of the fragrance preferences (250 characters at most), in the user's own words. An empty string clears it.

signature_scent.description: Signature scent: a perfume `id`, Parfumo URL or numeric `p_id`; "none" removes it.

time_zone.description: Time zone of the account, e.g. "Europe / Zurich".

name: parfumo_update_profile

EntityRef.description: Reference to a brand, perfumer or fragrance note.

numeric_id.description: Numeric Parfumo identifier (b_id, pf_id or note id) when the page exposes it.

FragrancePreferences.description: Free-text fragrance preferences shown on the profile.

i_dont_like.description: "I don't like" line (250 characters at most).

SettingOption.description: One choice of a setting that takes a value from a list.

value.description: Value to pass to change the setting.

SettingOut.description: One setting with its current value.

field.description: Name of the setting: pass it to parfumo_update_settings.

options.description: Choices of a `choice` setting; omitted when there are more than 30 (use `options_of`).

options_total.description: Number of choices of a `choice` setting.

value.description: Current value; absent when the page does not mark the selected choice.

SettingsPage.description: The settings pages of an account.

oneOf.description: Website language and display, mailbox, shelves, Souk.

WriteCall.description:
A write request to Parfumo, as built before being sent (also shown by `dry_run`).
The session `csrf_key` is added at send time and never appears here.

form.description: Form fields (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`), without the CSRF token.

dry_run.description: True when nothing was sent to Parfumo.

executed.description: True when at least one write request was sent.

fragrance_preferences.description: Fragrance preferences after the call; present when the call was about them.

notes.description: Side effects and things to know.

personal_details.description: Gender, country and time zone as Parfumo holds them after the call (before it in a dry run).

planned_requests.description: The write requests sent, or that would be sent.

public_writes_enabled.description: Whether this server is allowed to send publicly visible writes (operator setting).

signature_scent.description: Signature scent after the call; present when the call was about it and one is set.
